strategies.name: Value-Oriented (Warren)
strategies.description: Fundamental, margin-of-safety based ideas: select high-quality companies, size conservatively, hold for multi-week/months, focus on downside protection.
strategies.limitations: Fundamental scoring is a scaffold; ticker mapping for NSE needs refinement.
strategies.next_steps: Enrich screener with financial ratios, earnings, paid fundamentals API.

strategies.name: Growth/Scale-Oriented (Elon)
strategies.description: Automation-first, trend capture, scaling position size with confidence, monitoring and telemetry.
strategies.limitations: Observability stack not deployed; real-time scaling guardrails needed.
strategies.next_steps: Add tuned scaling policies and Grafana dashboards.

strategies.name: Hybrid / Combined
strategies.description: Combine fundamental screening with automated execution and risk controls.
strategies.limitations: Combined backtest scenarios and parameter sweeps to be implemented.
strategies.next_steps: Add grid search harness and combined backtests.

strategies.name: Execution & Risk Controls
strategies.description: ATR/static stops, realistic fill modeling, metrics and durable persistence.
implemented_features: ATR stops, slippage, commission in backtester
strategies.limitations: Partial fills and richer execution QA not yet modeled.
strategies.next_steps: Record raw fills, reconciliation, simulate partial fills.

strategies.name: Screening & Data
strategies.description: Broker LTP/candles, yfinance, Alpha Vantage, CSV historicals.
strategies.limitations: Ticker/token mapping for NSE requires domain mapping.
strategies.next_steps: Resolve symbol/token mapping and add paid data sources.

strategies.name: Profit Vaulting & Automation
strategies.description: Sweep realized profits into a vault and optionally auto-release on rules/schedule.
strategies.next_steps: Tune release policy and add UI controls.

strategies.name: Monitoring, Alerts & Notifications
strategies.description: Prometheus metrics, /metrics endpoint, monitoring routines and Telegram alerts.
strategies.limitations: Alert rules, Grafana dashboards, and escalation not configured.
strategies.next_steps: Deploy Prometheus + Grafana and configure alerts.

strategies.name: Backtesting & Validation
strategies.description: Deterministic replay backtester with ATR stops, slippage, commission, next-open fills.
strategies.next_steps: Add parameter sweeps and more realistic slippage models.

strategies.name: Operational / Deployment
strategies.description: Docker, Kubernetes manifests and secrets considerations.
strategies.next_steps: Provide bootstrap scripts and containerized observability stack.

strategies.name: Tests & CI
strategies.description: Unit tests added, test fixes applied, warnings resolved.
strategies.next_steps: Add CI workflows and coverage thresholds.
